name: Mammography — one series into the four standard views
notes: A screening mammogram often arrives as a single series holding all four
views. The standard `singleImageModality` rule gives each MG instance its
own display set, but it does not name the view. This rule groups by
laterality and view, and labels each display set with the view name.
The rule runs at priority -1, before every standard rule, so it claims MG
Grouping is by laterality and view. ViewPosition (0018,5101) is listed
first for the vendors that send it; PatientOrientation is the fallback
that separates CC from MLO when they do not (RCC P\L, RMLO P\FL,
LCC A\R, LMLO A\FR). Both are DICOM keywords, so the grouping itself
needs nothing registered on the host.
The view *name* does need code: it lives in ViewCodeSequence, which no
keyword reads. Hence the `mammoView` and `viewCode` context entries in
`requires` — the host registers them as code entries of its metadata
context, and the rule reads them by name like any keyword.
This file only decides *which* display sets exist. Where each one hangs is
a hanging protocol's job — see OHIF's hpMammo for the 2x2 CC-over-MLO
arrangement built on these same view codes.

mammoViewSplit.description: Mammography: split a single MG series into one display set per laterality/view, so RCC, RMLO, LCC and LMLO are separately selectable.
